hero_eyebrow: NPTC Qualified — Fully Insured Tree Surgery
hero_subhead: Overgrown trees damaging your property? We safely fell, prune and remove trees across Leeds — with same-week appointments.
services_heading: Complete Tree Surgery Services Across Leeds
services_subhead: From routine pruning to emergency storm damage, we handle every aspect of tree care with certified expertise and full insurance cover.

services.title: Tree Felling & Removal
services.desc: Safe, controlled felling of large or problem trees. We handle site clearance and haul away all waste, leaving your garden ready to use again.

services.title: Crown Reduction & Pruning
services.desc: Reduce overgrown canopies to restore light and air. Improves tree health and prevents damage to roofs, gutters and neighbouring properties.

services.title: Stump Grinding & Removal
services.desc: Grind out unsightly stumps below ground level so you can replant or reclaim garden space. We handle disposal of all debris.

services.title: Emergency Storm Damage
services.desc: Storm brought down a tree? We respond quickly to fallen branches and damaged limbs threatening your home or safety.

services.title: Dead Wood Removal
services.desc: Safely remove dead or diseased limbs that pose a fall risk. Regular inspection keeps your trees healthy and safe year-round.

services.title: Tree Reports & Surveys
services.desc: Detailed tree health assessments and risk surveys for insurance claims or planning permission. Written reports provided within 48 hours.

about_pullquote: I started this business because I hated seeing tree cowboys overcharge homeowners for shoddy work.
about_para_1: RD Forestry was founded in 2006 by Rob Davis, a qualified arborist with over 18 years' hands-on experience in tree surgery across Yorkshire. We've built our reputation on honest pricing, safe practice, and leaving every garden cleaner than we found it. Today, we're the go-to arborists for hundreds of Leeds homeowners and businesses who trust us with their most valuable green assets.
about_para_2: Our strength lies in combining technical skill with real customer care. We're NPTC qualified, fully insured, and we never push unnecessary work. Every job—whether a simple tidy-up or a complex multi-tree removal—gets the same level of attention to detail and safety. Customers come back to us because we listen, we're transparent about costs, and we turn potentially dangerous situations into tidy, manageable outcomes.
reviews_heading: What Leeds Homeowners Say About RD Forestry

reviews.text: Had a massive oak tree hanging over the garage after the storm last month. Rob came out, assessed it properly, quoted fair, and removed it safely without a scratch on the house. Cleared the whole lot away the same day. Couldn't ask for better.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Three quotes for the same job. Rob's was the most honest—he talked us out of removing one tree we didn't need to, which saved us money. That's why we trust him. Professional crew, tidy finish, very pleased.
reviews.author: Sarah P.

reviews.text: Emergency call on a Saturday morning—tree blocking the driveway after heavy snow. Rob was here by mid-afternoon with two crew and had it sorted by evening. Real professionals, and didn't overcharge for the weekend work. Recommended to all my neighbours.
reviews.author: James W.
